title: Trump’s Republicans scramble to stop Democratic midterms wave

blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Republicans made a final push Sunday to prevent a predicted thumping in US midterm elections where Democrats are gunning to win Congress and impose a first political check on President Donald Trump’s unprecedented pursuit of power. Polls show Democrats are all but certain to take the majority from Republicans in the House
